chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad and Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from al-Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams (peace be upon him), said:
I asked him about the man who performs ablution, should he cover the interior of his beard? He said: No.

key_terms.يُبَطِّنُ: covers the interior / lines the inside

ai.seo_question: Do I need to wash under my beard during wudu?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the extent of washing the face during wudu, establishing that the beard's interior need not be washed, a ruling derived from the principle of washing the 'visible' parts. It reflects the Shia scholarly consensus on the literal interpretation of the Quranic command to wash the face, distinguishing it from practices that might require wiping or washing the entire beard volume. This ruling is foundational in fiqh for determining the completeness of ablution, ensuring that the obligation is fulfilled without unnecessary burden.
